clips.title: The story
paras: High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind guides her people from the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. The sanctuary is the seat of government on Teldrassil and home to the Sisterhood of Elune, whose priestesses tend a sacred moonwell.

Built soon after the Third War, the Temple of the Moon rose as the night elves settled Teldrassil. It is among the largest stone structures made by modern kaldorei hands. Its marble came from quarries on the Kalimdor mainland and crossed the sea by magical means. At the heart of the temple, a broad moonwell rests beneath the statue of Haidene. Pilgrims come to worship and reflect beside its consecrated waters. The temple also holds Darnassus's highest seat of government, where High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind guides her people through a new age.

The priestesses of the Sisterhood of Elune serve their goddess from the temple's terraces, in worship and in the field. Emissaries and dispatched sisters travel across northern Kalimdor to investigate threats or aid local sentinels. Priestess Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde, for example, makes inquiries along the Darkshore coastline. Novices and veteran priestesses gather beneath the starry vaulted ceiling to learn divine spellwork, tend the wounded, and guard the sanctum from outside corruption.
